platform: Apple Silicon macOS, native Metal release studio
camera: Front view and Frame garment after the accepted drape. The inset fit uses 28 px on each side. Canvas bounds are measured on the 1640 × 1000 workspace PNG; the overlay exclusion includes its shadow.

actions.action: Open a disposable copy of the two-fabric Harbor, Frame all, choose Front view and start Assemble (gravity off).
Choose View > Strain map. Under the pending assembly, type the range values and commit each with Return.
Read accepted assembly, then start Drape. The map continues to show the accepted assembly while draping.
Read the accepted drape. Frame garment and use File > Export OBJ.
Toggle the map off, export the workspace, turn it on and export again. Enter 125%, export, restore 120%, then repeat both off and on captures.
Select Harbor front in Scene and isolate it. Show all again.
Save the editable project. Choose New Empty, observe Current surface unavailable at revision 0, then reopen the saved primary through the native chooser and save again.
Open the edited Pocket fixture. Turn off the map, Frame all, select the pattern and export the workspace to inspect the sloped cutout.

limits: Global maximum principal stretch per face; continuous original display colors. The separate historical fitting grade uses its own 15% material-axis test.

One two-fabric drape and one selected cutout on this workstation. Dark and outline-similar authored colors are exercised by source tests. Numerical comparison with a reference solver, graph-style modes, fabric calibration, stress and pressure remain open.
